judge_notes.opus55: An unbooked ~$120M IEEPA refund on a GAAP-only reporter that peers recognised this quarter (item 0, sized as a one-off), plus short interest that doubled into a call-bid skew.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Unrecognized IEEPA refund (about $120M paid, peers booked theirs) could add 20-30% to GAAP EPS and lift the FY guide (item 0), with doubled short interest and call-bid skew; offset by On Holding read-through and UGG demand proxy.
judge_notes.fable51: A ~$120M IEEPA refund excluded from a guide the consensus barely clears (i0), a short that doubled into a call-bid skew (i2) and cheaper buybacks (i1); refunds have split by guidance direction before, and the UGG search series (i4) is the H2 risk.
